verdict.rationale: Smithery's Uplink feature explicitly exposes an MCP server running on any local machine as a regular Smithery connection, letting developers test/use a locally running server against real agents without deploying it, and this is backed by scoped tokens and managed OAuth/credential handling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of Uplink working end-to-end (only first-party docs cited) and no detail on latency/reliability of the bridged local connection.
